Cloning vectors are engineered to facilitate the linking of foreign DNA and the selection of transformants. The plasmid pBR322 was one of the earliest artificial cloning vectors constructed. detailedSolution:

According to NCERT principles for Biotechnology and its Applications (Agrobacterium Tumefaciens Ti Plasmid):
Deliver desired genes into plants without inducing crown gall tumors (disarmed vector)

1. Agrobacterium tumefaciens delivers a piece of DNA known as 'T-DNA' to transform normal plant cells into a tumor.
2. The tumor inducing (Ti) plasmid of Agrobacterium tumefaciens has now been modified into a cloning vector which is no more pathogenic to the plants but is still able to use the mechanisms to deliver genes of our interest.
Hence Option A is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.
